shadows.name: map-card
shadows.purpose: Separate the light workflow cards from the dark canvas.

shadows.name: mobile-sheet
shadows.purpose: Show that settings overlap the map on mobile.

narrative.northStar: A readable map with one place to focus
narrative.overview: Gator's existing canvas becomes a numbered map of configured actions. Named source links explain the information each block uses. A single inspector holds the detailed settings, becoming a bottom sheet on mobile.

rules.name: Named Data
rules.body: Identify the source block and output rather than relying on wire color.

dos: Preserve the editable graph and existing dashboard controls.
donts: Do not promote this workflow-specific contract into a site-wide brand replacement.
